comment: Dr. Robert’s is a gifted storyteller who is able to make the personalities and particularities of kings, queens, and politicians of the past spring to life in his lectures.  Each lecture conveyed his enthusiasm, interest, and command of the subject of Early Modern England.  As such, each class was an experience to be looked forward to.
Best CORE teacher ever, unfortunately he doesn't teach it anymore! Dr. Roberts is the best professor at UR.
